binary_inspection.method: readelf dynamic NEEDED plus strings/nm inspection of the exact hash-locked, unstripped Linux binaries

basis: Every native repository named by the exact workerd Bazel module derivation is pinned by full commit and/or source archive SHA-256.
All licence-like files in each pinned named component tree are vendored conservatively, including build/test-only notices that may not enter the binary.
The exact NPM wrapper, architecture package, and binary hashes are locked for linux-amd64 and linux-arm64.
Unstripped binary inspection found no native external-repository marker outside the named closure; dynamic dependencies are only the Debian-provided loader, libc, and libm.

No mandatory native corresponding-source obligation remains: zstd is used under BSD-3-Clause; the V8 glibc notice is conservatively included but bundled glibc trig symbols were not found and both binaries dynamically depend on libm.
The selected Perfetto client target reaches RE2; RE2 and its Abseil dependency are covered. Protobuf is used by protoc during generation and no protobuf runtime markers occur in either final binary.
Static LLVM libc++/libc++abi/compiler-rt and GCC runtime/startup obligations are explicitly covered from the exact release workflow, linker flags, toolchain comments, and binary symbols.

build_only_not_distributed.name: protobuf
build_only_not_distributed.reason: Perfetto protoc/code-generation input; generated Perfetto protozero C++ is linked, not libprotobuf.

build_only_not_distributed.name: perfetto optional extension repositories
build_only_not_distributed.reason: SQLite, zlib, Expat, linenoise, LLVM demangler, and OpenCSD repositories are declared by the generic Perfetto extension but are not reachable from libperfetto_client_experimental. Direct workerd SQLite/zlib are separately covered.

gcc-static-runtime.basis: Release .bazelrc uses -static-libgcc and binary .comment identifies Ubuntu GCC 12.3.0; GCC Runtime Library Exception removes corresponding-source obligation for eligible compilation.

glibc-startup.basis: The PIE startup path calls dynamic __libc_start_main; no separately linked glibc library is hidden from NEEDED.
glibc-startup.coverage: container-wide Debian notice/source lock plus glibc startup-file exception

libc-libm-loader.basis: The only dynamic NEEDED libraries are the platform loader, libc, and libm from the final Debian image.
libc-libm-loader.coverage: container-wide Debian notice and corresponding-source lock

llvm-static-runtime.basis: Release setup installs LLVM 19 libc++/compiler-rt and .bazelrc statically links libc++.a; binary paths identify libcxxabi.

gcc-runtime.scope: Complete root COPYING family plus a recursive legal-filename scan of the selected libgcc runtime subtree.

llvm-runtime.scope: Recursive legal-filename scans of the four selected linked LLVM runtime subtrees, not unrelated llvm-project tools.

perfetto.scope: Recursive legal-filename scan of the complete pinned Perfetto repository tree.

re2.scope: Recursive legal-filename scan of the complete pinned RE2 repository tree.

legal_gate.dynamic_library_owner: Debian dpkg source/notices inventory outside this native workerd bundle

residual_limitations.detail: The NPM release has no signed native SBOM or reproducible-build attestation. Downstream evidence binds the exact release workflow, linker flags, LLVM/GCC toolchain, direct Bazel sources, package hashes, and binary markers, but Cloudflare does not sign that assembled closure.
residual_limitations.effect: Does not identify a missing notice or corresponding-source obligation; retained as uncertainty about upstream binary provenance/feature attestation.
residual_limitations.mitigation: Self-build workerd from the pinned source with a captured Bazel cquery/aquery closure, reproduce the released binary, or obtain signed upstream provenance and reconcile it to this lock.

residual_limitations.detail: The upstream NPM release does not publish a machine-verifiable configured Bazel closure. The pinned source graph was reviewed through workerd -> libperfetto_client_experimental -> src_base_regex_regex -> RE2, and the selected native repositories are covered, but this remains independent downstream evidence.
residual_limitations.effect: Does not identify a missing notice or source obligation; it records that the reviewed V8/Perfetto target-closure evidence is downstream rather than an upstream-signed attestation.
residual_limitations.mitigation: Capture the exact configured Bazel target closure and add every external runtime repository, notice, and source digest before closing this evidence limitation.

scope: Conservative native C/C++ dependency notice inventory for the published workerd 1.20260708.1 Linux binaries. Rust crates are intentionally excluded and inventoried separately.
